pattern: category pages: safe and weak anchors

tiers.safe: acceptable when the user asks for 'aman' (safe); never offered as the good option
tiers.avoid: safe but not good; avoid when the user wants a good design

owner_notes: standard category page, not unique but safe, as long as it combines image and text

style_levers.surface: black ground, white card headers with the artist name, coloured photo panels
style_levers.detail: red Play Now pill, underline tabs

coordinator_notes: works because every card pairs a face with a name; reads as a template because all cards are the same size and treatment

owner_notes: very ordinary: small icon categories; safe but not good or unique; avoid if the user wants a good design

style_levers.layout: row of square icon tiles with two-line labels under, promo banners below
style_levers.detail: illustrated object icons, voucher and rewards cards

coordinator_notes: the icon-tile row is the marketplace default; labels wrapping to two lines and many competing promos make it busy

owner_notes: a very bad UI because it is very ordinary

style_levers.layout: search, three emoji tiles, all-caps tabs, empty state, floating Done button

coordinator_notes: neutral note: the empty state itself is sound UX (explains why it is empty and offers Create food); what reads as bad is the visual: emoji as category icons, all-caps tabs, a large empty field, a floating Done with no clear role
keep it as a negative anchor for the visual layer, not for the empty-state pattern
